deepDive.markdownContent:
## Supply Chain Security & SBOMs

This deep dive walks through when to apply **Supply Chain Security & SBOMs**, how it interacts with adjacent patterns, and which signals prove it is working in production.

### Operating checklist

- Define success metrics and failure budgets.
- Validate behavior under partial outages.
- Keep runbooks and diagrams current for on-call engineers.

caseStudy.problem: Repeated incidents traced to gaps in Supply Chain Security & SBOMs practices
caseStudy.solution: Standardized Supply Chain Security & SBOMs with explicit invariants, dashboards, and game-day exercises
caseStudy.impact: Lower MTTR and fewer customer-impacting regressions
